context.description: Ordered context describing where it happened.

retryable.description: Whether retrying the same operation may succeed.

description: The stable JSON envelope every `qqqai` command emits under `--json`. `schema_version` is bumped only for a breaking change within a major version.

data.description: The command's payload, when it succeeded.

ok.description: Whether the command succeeded. **`ok` is not the exit status.** It says the command did what it was asked and produced this payload; it is `true` even when the payload reports a problem — `doctor` finding a missing manifest is a successful diagnosis. producer.description: Always `"qqqai"`, so a consumer can tell at a glance what produced this.

schema_version.description: The machine-contract version this conforms to.
